definition: An unsanctioned high-speed transit route across Lake Michigan, typically by submersible drone-sled or modified water taxi, used to move contraband, refugees, or persons of interest outside monitored corridors. The cold water disrupts most tracking signatures.
origin: Old Harbor smuggler slang, predating the megacity corridor; one of the oldest terms in continuous use
usage: Smugglers, refugee networks, fixers, and anyone needing to move between Chicago and Milwaukee without a Diaspora footprint
example: Forget the tube — if Ferrogate Security has your biometrics flagged, your only option is a lakerun. Expensive, but you'll arrive clean.
